suggestions.what: Implement a custom empty state view in `HabitsView` when the `habits` array is empty.
suggestions.why: This provides clear guidance to users on how to get started and improves the first-run experience.

suggestions.what: Add an empty state message and call to action in `JournalView` when `journalEntries` is empty.
suggestions.why: Users will understand why the list is blank and be prompted to create their first journal entry.

suggestions.what: Display a dedicated empty state view in `GymView` when no `gymLogs` are present.
suggestions.why: This helps users understand that no workout data has been recorded yet and encourages them to add a log.

suggestions.what: Introduce an empty state view in `GroceriesView` to inform users when their `groceryItems` list is empty.
suggestions.why: It provides a friendly prompt for users to start building their grocery list, improving usability.

suggestions.what: Implement an empty state view in `EmotionsView` for when there are no `emotionLogs` to display.
suggestions.why: This guides users to log their emotions, making the app more intuitive for new or infrequent users.

suggestions.what: Add an empty state view to `SpiritualityView` to indicate when no `spiritualityPractices` have been added.
suggestions.why: It encourages engagement by clearly showing how to begin tracking spiritual practices.

suggestions.what: Display a `ProgressView` or skeleton loader in `HabitsView` while `habits` data is being fetched.
suggestions.why: This provides visual feedback to the user that content is loading, preventing perceived delays or app unresponsiveness.

suggestions.what: Incorporate a loading indicator in `JournalView` to show progress when `journalEntries` are being loaded.
suggestions.why: Users will have a better experience by understanding that the app is actively retrieving their journal data.

suggestions.what: Add a loading state (e.g., `ProgressView`) to `GymView` while `gymLogs` are being asynchronously retrieved.
suggestions.why: This improves perceived performance and user satisfaction by indicating that data is being processed.

suggestions.what: Add `.accessibilityLabel` to the greeting and date `Text` views in `HomeView` for screen reader clarity.
suggestions.why: This ensures that visually impaired users receive clear and descriptive information about the displayed greeting and current date.
